title: MLEADERSTYLE parser and writer share documented enum domains
mode: P2 local source/writer domain correctness slice with generated ASCII/Binary controls
scope: Share valid integer domains for MLEADERSTYLE groups 170, 171, 172, 173, 175, 176, 177, 271, 272 and 273 between DXF source parsing and the typed DXF writer.
Accept every modeled enum value and reject one value on each side of each supported domain in generated ASCII and Binary DXF.
Reuse the same dx_iface after malformed imports and keep all authored test drawings temporary.

sources.title: Autodesk MLEADERSTYLE DXF reference
sources.supports: Maps groups 170-177, 178, and 271-273 to the MLEADERSTYLE fields; identifies group 271 as 0=horizontal or 1=vertical and groups 272/273 as center 9 or underlined/overlined center 10.

sources.title: Autodesk ObjectARX AcDbMLeaderStyle enumeration reference
sources.supports: Identifies the official ContentType, DrawMLeaderOrderType, DrawLeaderOrderType, LeaderType, TextAlignmentType, TextAngleType, and TextAttachmentDirection enumerations.

sources.title: Autodesk ObjectARX and Managed Reference enumeration definitions
sources.supports: Defines the finite values used by the shared validator: content 0-3; draw orders 0-1; leader type 0-2; text angle/alignment 0-2; block connection 0-1; and MText text-attachment direction 0-1.

evidence.sourceCreation: The test generates a rooted AC1027 MLEADERSTYLE drawing locally, changes one field at a time, and transcodes the same authored drawing to Binary DXF when required. Scratch drawings are deleted by the test.

implementation.summary: Added DRW_MLeaderStyle::isValidDxfEnumValue with one domain table. The parser validates before converting source values to uint16_t, and the typed writer now calls the same helper for its corresponding fields.
behaviorChanges: Out-of-domain signed and high values in the covered fields fail source parsing instead of wrapping or silently entering the typed model.
Previously accepted and writer-supported values remain accepted through source parsing, including the local zero defaults for groups 272 and 273.
The same writer and parser use one validator, preventing domain drift.
implementation.publicApiOrLayoutChanged: Added a static validation method; object layout and virtual interface are unchanged.

results.focusedCTest: PASS 4/4 in 3.6 seconds, including direct-writer domains, writer closure, prior boolean input validation, and the new source-domain matrix.

limitations: Groups 174 and 178, style version 179, max leader point count, lineweight boundaries, field presence/repetition and version-specific source rules remain outside this slice.
No native annotation/rendering, whole-document, platform, ABI, LibreCAD, LibreCAD_3, FreeCAD, or producer qualification is established.

planImpact.nextImplementationPacket: Resolve one witnessed MLEADERSTYLE source-presence/reference gap or one current LTYPE/XDATA dependency failure; do not broaden the enum matrix without a distinct documented domain.

worktree: Only the five listed implementation/test files, this receipt, and the plan update are part of this slice; unrelated untracked files were not staged.
